name: Angels And Death
overview: Scripture reveals that angels play a significant role in the divine administration of life and death, acting as ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation (Hebrews 1:14). The death of God's saints is precious in His sight, underscoring His care even in their passing (Psalms 116:15). Angels are also involved in God's judgment and protection, as seen in the command to pour out His wrath (Revelation 16:1) and the protective stand of Michael for God's people during times of great trouble (Daniel 12:1). Furthermore, at the resurrection, believers will be like angels, transcending earthly institutions such as marriage (Mark 12:25), and nothing, including angels or death itself, can separate believers from the love of God (Romans 8:38).
